answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes three unpredictable challenge words, e.g. oasis, knoll, garden, which every agent must embed in its signed proof-of-service for that epoch. Since the words are revealed only when the epoch opens, attackers cannot precompute template answers: each fake identity needs fresh attested work every round, so a sybil farm pays real compute, latency, and fees per identity per epoch, making mass identity generation unprofitable while honest agents absorb one extra word.
